review_notes: Baralwa/Khagdkot road-blocking slide is real, but Jul 11 articles attribute it to previous-night rain and ongoing rockfall without distinguishing whether the physical slide began Jul 10 or early Jul 11. Exact event date is not release-safe.
This article concerns Mahakali flooding and the Banbasa crossing; its generic mention of landslides in hill districts establishes no individually dated or located Darchula landslide.

Bigu-3 Olitar landslide and zero human casualties are clear, but Aug 27 publication says only "last night" without an occurrence time to resolve Aug 26 evening versus Aug 27 early morning. Exact date cannot be established safely.
Khandachakra-3 Galli road-obstructing slide is real, but the Monday 05:55 report attributes it to Sunday-night rain without an exact slide time; cannot establish Jun 21 versus early Jun 22 safely.

The recoverable original Nagarik page is an earthquake-weakened-slope topic with no dated, individually located Kathmandu physical landslide; publication metadata alone cannot validate this candidate.

The documented landslide was at Gaurikund, Uttarakhand, India. Patrasi/Jumla is the missing victims' home municipality, not a Nepal event site; no canonical Nepal district/municipality can be proposed.

ICIMOD expert locates the landslide dam between Khasa and Nyalam in Tibet, outside Nepal. Flood impacts in Sindhupalchok are downstream and the four dozen historical deaths refer to 1996, not this 2016 slide.

Original articles concern multiple earthquake-era landslide settings, including Trishuli-3A and distinct Gorkha/Dolakha accounts. They do not identify one May 6 physical Kathmandu event or justify the three-article merged identity.
